name: product-taxonomy-council
displayName: Product Taxonomy Council — Naming & Service Governance
description: Convene a standing product-naming and taxonomy-governance council whenever a new product, service or feature is being named, an existing name is questioned, or the product/service catalog or taxonomy is touched. The Chief Product Architect always chairs; specialists (Product Taxonomy/Information Architect, Naming & Verbal-Identity Lead, Brand Architect, Platform/DevRel Strategist, Product Manager, Catalog/Governance Steward) brief on the business/positioning first, ground in the existing catalog and brand system, research PRIMARY sources on disciplined naming practice (AWS/GCP/Azure + IA/taxonomy + verbal-identity), generate meaningful non-trivial names (think outside the box, not dictionary-obvious), run 2 focused consensus rounds (diverge then converge; a Sonnet moderator synthesizes, the top-tier model stays executive), stay unbiased on rejection (produce fresh valid alternatives, never re-defend a rejected name), and converge to a naming decision, catalog entries, and an ADR-ready record.
author: RiseGen AI

usage.aiAssistants: MANDATORY to invoke before naming any new product/service/feature, before shipping a rename, or before touching the catalog/taxonomy; read SKILL.md, then run the phased session (ground + business/positioning brief -> primary-source research -> 2 consensus rounds [diverge, then converge], Sonnet moderates, top model executive, meaningful non-trivial names, unbiased on rejection -> naming decision + catalog entries + ADR-ready record).
usage.engineers: The council roster, the session protocol, and the naming-decision deliverable format.
usage.founders: A repeatable, senior naming and taxonomy-governance room that protects the ecosystem's product/service branding as it grows.
